posts.html:
Want to become a ||VM|| Donator?

Quick Link: www.ventmob.com/donate

Information

By donating money to the ||Vent Mob|| Community you help keep our severs alive and our updates comming! All the money goes towards hosting the server and the time spent making the complex Lua coding to our updates for the server. Note: Refunds cannot be given.

There are two teirs of donators: Donator & Super Donator

Advantages of Being a Donator


Donator Advantages:
$50,000 -In-Game Cash-
Physics Gun
Ability to Spawn Props (includes PHX)
2 Pockets -In-Game Item-
Respected Donator Status on Forums + In Game: A symbol next to your name when you talk in OOC
$100 Salary In Game

Super Donator Advantages:
$120,000 -In-Game Cash-
Physics Gun
Ability to Spawn props (includes PHX)
6 Pockets -In-Game Item-
5 Breachers -In-Game Item-
Respected Super Donator Status on Forums + In Game: A symbol next to your name when you talk in OOC
$100 Salary In Game

Costs

Donator = £5 ($7.50 or €5.60) Lasts 1 and a half Months (45 days)
Super Donator = £10 ($15 or €11.20) Lasts 3 Months

How to Pay

Made your mind up you want to be a Donator?

Go to: http://www.ventmob.com/donate/

For Help PM myself or another Admin on the forums.

Note: Any abuse of Donator Status then ||Vent Mob|| remain the right to revoke your Donator Privilages. Also you cannot buy yourself into having Admin/Moderator Status. Refunds can not be given.
